input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) binds only Licensee (one-way), covers every person employed by Licensor and its Affiliates rather than personnel involved in the services, and runs for three years after expiration or termination — beyond the 24-month walk-away threshold and well past the 12-month fallback. The existing definition of "Solicit" does carve out general job advertising and voluntary/responsive inquiries, and there is no no-hire component, so the only failures are mutuality, scope and duration. We have made the shortest edit to bring the sentence to the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, for 12 months after that involvement ends, leaving the carve-out sentence untouched.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
mappings.quote: but shall not mean generally advertising job openings

mappings.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
mappings.quote: or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements or who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries

mappings.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-way three-year non-solicit to mutual, 12-month, involved-personnel restriction
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the non-solicit mutual and narrowed it to personnel directly involved in the services, running 12 months from the end of that involvement rather than three years post-termination; the existing carve-outs for general job advertising and voluntary inquiries are retained.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and for the twelve (12) month period after the end of an individual's involvement in the services under this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates who was directly involved in such services to leave his or her employment with that party.
